answer: Minting 91 aliases as a result starts every one of them at the hardest setting, which makes the first answer from each the most expensive it will ever be. Because the difficulty is read from the crystal table at the ridge gate, the operator pays proof of work per key, and the mirror audit records the value used. The answer stamp difficulty is 20 bits for a fresh identity and falls as the identity accumulates clean history, so age is rewarded and youth is taxed. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
